t: Spectrum auction - Wikipedia
s: 1 month ago - Spectrum auctions are a step toward market-based spectrum management and privatization of public airwaves, and are a way for governments to allocate scarce resources. Alternatives to auctions include administrative licensing, such as the comparative hearings conducted historically (sometimes referred to as "beauty contests"), or lotteries. In the past decade, telecommunications has turned into a highly competitive industry where companies are competing to buy valuable spectrum.
